A_hf.golden: QwenImageEditPipeline.__call__(image, prompt, negative_prompt=' ', true_cfg_scale=4.0, num_inference_steps=50, latents=<shared initial noise>, output_type='pt') in float32 on CPU

B_bringup.note: models/demos/qwen_image_edit holds no bringup_status.json: the model was brought up as three components and their folders ARE Source B. VAE: models/tt_dit/pipelines/qwen_image_edit_vae (re-graduated on this Galaxy: parallelism_manifest 32 chips, run as an 8x4 grid by _stubs/_mesh.py). Text encoder: models/demos/qwen_image_edit_text_encoder (graduated TP=4 x DP=2 on 2x4). Transformer: models/tt_dit/pipelines/qwen_image_edit_transformer (graduated TP=8 on 1x8).
B_bringup.graduation_rule: status NEW with a _stubs/<name>.py.last_good_native or .last_good_sharded snapshot. REUSE/ADAPT entries are not graduated work products even where they have a snapshot.
B_bringup.live_vs_snapshot_2026_09_25: VAE 11/11 live == snapshot, byte compare. Transformer: qwen_embed_rope and timesteps equal their snapshots. The other 5 transformer stubs and all 7 text-encoder stubs differ, from the committed T3K e2e work (precise mode, batch generalisation, 2x4 collectives). Those were re-verified then with their own tests/pcc (40/40). The live stub is the graduated body that gets composed.

graduated_modules.verified_by: bringup_status.json status==NEW + last_good snapshot, re-enumerated 2026-09-25 from all three bring-up folders: text encoder 7, VAE 11, transformer 7 = 25. No NEW entry lacks a snapshot. None is left out of the chain below.

vision_patch_embed.role: patch features 1176 -> 1280, the first op of the vision tower

v_l_vision_block.role: each of the 32 vision blocks (window / full attention)

vision_transformer_pretrained_model.role: the vision tower container: patch_embed -> window reorder -> 32 blocks -> merger -> reverse order; composed of the three stubs above

v_l_decoder_layer.role: each of the 28 LM decoder layers

language_model_layers_0_mlp.role: the SwiGLU MLP inside every decoder layer

v_l_text_model.role: the LM container: 28 decoder layers + final norm, composed of the two stubs above

qwen_image_encoder3d.role: VAE encode of the condition image (composed of the block stubs below)

qwen_image_decoder3d.role: VAE decode of the final latent (composed of the block stubs below)

zero_pad2d.role: the right/bottom zero pad before each stride-2 downsample conv

qwen_image_upsample.role: the spatial x2 upsample inside each decoder up-resample

non_graduated_used_as_glue.mlp: ADAPT (last_good_sharded): quant_conv 1x1x1 (and the same port for post_quant_conv)

vae.dir_note: VAE stubs re-graduated for Galaxy: physical_grid() reshapes a 1x32 mesh to 8x4 in place; H (or batch, batch_parallel=True) over the 8-axis, W over the 4-axis, zero-pad to the grid + crop.

qwen_timestep_proj_embeddings.role: temb = timestep_embedding(timesteps(t)), composed of the two stubs above

qwen_embed_rope.role: 3-axis RoPE tables for [noise latent, condition latent] + text

non_graduated_used_as_glue.patch_embed: ADAPT (last_good_native): img_in; the same Linear port builds txt_in
non_graduated_used_as_glue.attention: REUSE (last_good_sharded): joint attention inside each block (the block body uses it)

not_used_and_why.text_encoder.decoder_head (lm_head): ADAPT, not graduated. The edit pipeline takes hidden_states[-1] and never computes logits.
not_used_and_why.REUSE/ADAPT duplicates (text_encoder att: not graduated work products; each is the same class as, or a thinner wrapper of, a graduated module above

task_heads.name: image_edit
task_heads.input: PIL image(s) + edit instruction(s). The HF VaeImageProcessor resizes to calculate_dimensions(area, aspect) and preprocesses to [-1,1] for the VAE. The HF Qwen2VLProcessor builds input_ids / attention_mask / pixel_values / image_grid_thw from the pipeline prompt template, for the prompt and for negative_prompt=' '. Initial noise comes from the per-sample torch.Generator(seed) via diffusers randn_tensor.
task_heads.output: edited image tensor [B, 3, H, W] in [0,1] (HF postprocess output_type='pt'); the demo also saves PNGs
chain: vision_encode: vision_transformer_pretrained_model(vision_patch_embed -> 32 x v_l_vision_block -> v_l_patch_merger) on the resized condition image

text_encode: token_embed(ids) with the image embeddings spliced at the <|image_pad|> run -> v_l_text_model (28 x v_l_decoder_layer, each with language_model_layers_0_mlp; TP=4 on mesh axis 1, stage-split over the 8-row axis: rows 0-3 hold layers 0-13 and rows 4-7 hold layers 14-27) -> drop the 64 template tokens -> prompt_embeds (+mask), cond and uncond
vae_encode: qwen_image_encoder3d -> quant_conv -> mode (first z_dim channels) -> (x - mean)/std -> 2x2 pack -> image_latents

denoise x num_inference_steps: batch split over mesh axis 1 (DP=4, 8 samples per column), transformer TP=8 over mesh axis 0. cat[latents, image_latents] -> img_in; txt_norm -> txt_in; qwen_timestep_proj_embeddings(t/1000); rope = qwen_embed_rope([(1,h,w),(1,h,w)], txt_len) -> 60 x qwen_image_transformer_block -> ada_layer_norm_continuous -> proj_out -> noise_pred[:, :S_latent]; same for uncond; true-CFG combine + norm rescale; flow-match Euler step
vae_decode: all_gather the latents over axis 1 -> unpack -> x*std + mean -> post_quant_conv -> qwen_image_decoder3d (batch over the 8-axis, W over the 4-axis) -> clamp(-1,1) -> (x+1)/2
task_heads.agent: one agent: there is a single call, and it uses all 25 graduated modules

pass_definition.gate1_native: every routed graduated stub is ttnn: no torch compute in its forward (static AST scan of stubs + glue + chain) and zero host aten ops in the observed forward (host_op_observer). Sharded bodies stay sharded (ShardTensorToMesh / ShardTensor2dMesh + CCL on the TP axis); the TP axis is re-pointed to the 8x4 mesh, never replicated away.
pass_definition.gate2_invoked: each of the 25 graduated modules records >=1 call during the real image_edit forward. Counters sit on the stub instances inside the chain; there is no coverage sweep.
pass_definition.gate3_pcc: final image PCC >= 0.99 vs the HF golden, per sample, for ALL 32 samples at B=32 (the batch the test drives is read from the pipeline). Printed on every run as its own line, 'e2e PCC=<min over samples>', immediately before the asserts. It is the only line with 'PCC...=' in the output; per-sample lines use 'PCC ' without '='.
pass_definition.host_free: host_op_selftest(): zero non-benign aten ops inside the observed forward (encoded inputs -> image)
pass_definition.trace: trace_capture_selftest(): per stage, capture / execute / release; output PCC vs eager
pass_definition.time_budget: The harness runs tests/e2e/test_e2e_image_edit.py under a 2700 s hang timeout, so build + 32-sample forward + checks must fit in 45 min. The golden is precomputed and cached (reference/golden.py); the test fails fast if it is missing rather than building it (~hours on CPU).

validation_metric.primary: PCC(tt_image[b], hf_image[b]) >= 0.99 for every b in 0..31, over the full image tensor (no crop)
secondary: per-stage PCC printed (prompt_embeds, image_latents, step-0 noise_pred) for diagnosis
validation_metric.not_applicable: rendered-signal scores (WER/MOS) apply to audio output with a rate; this output is an image tensor, so PCC is the gate

behavioral_proof.real_input: the 32 bundled samples: 4 photos from models/sample_data x 8 distinct square crops, 32 distinct instructions, seeds 1000..1031, encoded by the HF processors (tt/inputs.py). Same set as the T3K run, so its per-sample findings carry over.
behavioral_proof.independence_check: assert the 32 TT outputs are pairwise distinct, and each matches its own golden better than any other sample's golden
behavioral_proof.no_injection: each stage consumes the previous TT stage's device tensor; the golden is used only for the final comparison

horizon.kind: diffusion (no autoregressive decode; no stop token)
horizon.steps: num_inference_steps = 50, the QwenImageEditPipeline default; the same schedule (sigmas linspace(1, 1/50, 50) + dynamic shift mu(image_seq_len)) on both sides. The whole schedule runs; nothing is truncated.

resolution.area: 256*256 for the gate. The HF pipeline hard-codes calculate_dimensions(1024*1024) for the condition image; the golden runs the same pipeline with that target area overridden to 256*256, which gives 256x256 for square inputs (512 image tokens + ~100 text tokens).
resolution.why: The fp32 CPU golden costs ~10 s per sample-forward at 612 tokens, measured this run (B=4 took 38.9 s). 32 samples x 2 (CFG) x 50 steps is ~8.6 h at 256^2; 1024^2 (~9600 tokens) would be ~15x larger and quadratic in attention, so it is out of reach for 32 goldens. The demo exposes --area for other sizes.

batch.axis: leading axis of every tensor, one program per step for all 32
batch.per_stage: vision_encode: 32 images replicated over rows, TP=4 over the 4 columns. text_encode: 64 sequences (32 prompts + 32 negatives). vae_encode: batch over the 8-axis (4 per row). denoise: batch over the 4-axis (8 per column), TP=8 on the 8-axis. Cond and uncond are two B_local=8 transformer calls. vae_decode: batch over the 8-axis (4 per row, one program if memory allows).
batch.ceilings: No ceiling assumed. The T3K STAGE_MAX_BATCH (vae_decode 16, text 2x32) was measured on 2x4 and must be re-measured here. Keep one only if it reproduces on the 8x4 mesh, with the measurement recorded.

hardware.box: GalaxyWH, 32 x Wormhole, opened as an 8x4 mesh (the physical grid; same 32 chips as the harness's --mesh 4,8 = DP4 x TP8)
hardware.ceiling_used: 10.5 GB usable per chip, the registered figure with a CCL axis in play

per_chip_budget_estimate_GB.note: carried from the T3K measurements of the same per-chip splits (TP=8 transformer, TP=4 x half the LM layers per chip, replicated VAE weights). Not re-measured on this Galaxy yet; the build must re-measure and record it. Rejected: the whole LM replicated on every row, 4.72 + 5.36 + 0.41 = 10.49 GB, which leaves no activation headroom under 10.5.

self_validation_plan: 1. HF golden: fp32 CPU, B=32, 50 steps, cached with its intermediates under _golden/ (started 2026-09-25, reference/golden.py).

2. Port to 8x4: re-point the transformer TP axis (axis 0) + DP over axis 1; stage-split the text LM over rows; VAE as graduated. Re-run each modified stub's own tests/pcc on its graduated topology plus the 8x4 mesh.
3. Stage parity on device vs golden intermediates at B=32: prompt/neg embeds, image latents, step-0 latents, decode of the golden final latents.
4. Full e2e test at B=32, 50 steps, within 2700 s: Gate 1 (static scan + host_op_observer), Gate 2 (tracker counts for all 25), Gate 3 (per-sample PCC); 'e2e PCC=' printed before the asserts.

5. trace_capture_selftest (per stage, capture / replay / release; trace_region sized from the largest stage, measured) and host_op_selftest, zero-arg, each within the probes' 600 s budget; build_pipeline(layers=2) proves the depth knob.
6. Re-measure memory per chip and every batch ceiling on this Galaxy before finishing; run pre-commit on the emitted files.

decisions.mesh: MeshShape(8, 4) with FABRIC_1D. The VAE stubs were graduated on exactly this grid, and the text encoder's TP=4 axis stays mesh axis 1 as graduated. build_pipeline normalises a handed 1x32 or 4x8 mesh to 8x4 in place (device.reshape, the same call the VAE's physical_grid uses) before anything is allocated.
decisions.transformer: TP=8 over mesh axis 0 (graduated TP=8; 24 heads / 8 = 3), replicated over axis 1. Weights: ShardTensor2dMesh dims=(shard_dim, None). _ccl collectives run on axis 0 only (exact fp32 gather-sum kept). Activations batch-sharded over axis 1 (DP=4) with ttnn.mesh_partition from the replicated text/VAE outputs. After the last step, all_gather over axis 1 for the decode.
decisions.text_encoder: TP=4 on axis 1 as graduated. The LM is stage-split over the 8-row axis: rows 0-3 hold layers 0-13, rows 4-7 hold 14-27. This generalises the T3K row_stages (rows==2) to 2 stages of rows//2 rows each, with an exact all_gather hand-off over axis 0. Vision tower replicated over rows. Optional: split the batch over rows inside a stage.
decisions.vae: the re-graduated 8x4 stubs as-is: batch_parallel over the 8-axis, W over the 4-axis; quant/post_quant_conv via the mlp port.
decisions.precision: keep the T3K precise modes (text encoder precise + exact reduces; transformer _precise 2-limb / exact-lane QK^T). On T3K they gave per-stage PCC prompt 0.99994, VAE 0.99998, CFG noise per forward 0.9999956, and 20/32 images >= 0.99 over 50 steps. The Galaxy DP=4 cuts denoise time ~4x; spend any headroom under the 45 min budget on precision where the diagnosis points.
decisions.known_risk_gate3: On T3K the 50-step true-CFG trajectory was chaotic for some samples. The HF fp32 reference re-run at B=2 instead of B=32 gave only 0.953 (sample 30) and 0.966 (sample 26), so no non-bit-identical implementation can reach 0.99 on those. Plan: (1) measure per-sample PCC on the Galaxy; (2) on samples that fail with a stable reference, find the dominant stage (swap in one golden intermediate at a time, diagnosis only, never in the pipeline or the gate) and improve that stage's precision; (3) quantify reference self-consistency per sample. If Gate 3 still cannot be met, report it as NOT MET with the evidence. Do not drop or cherry-pick samples to pass it.
